In [[algebraic geometry]], a '''Steinerian''' of a [[hypersurface]], introduced by {{harvs|txt|last=Steiner|authorlink=Jakob Steiner|year=1854}},  is the [[locus (mathematics)|locus]] of the [[Singular point of an algebraic variety|singular points]] of its [[Glossary of classical algebraic geometry|polar quadrics]].
